entries.prompt: USE CASE: stylized-concept. Warwrit design reference image (not final game art, not canon). Grounded dark fantasy: a small mercenary company in a grey borderland kingdom split by a seven-year succession war between dukes; late-medieval Slavic-Northern material culture (timber, thatch, wool, mail, gambesons, spears, axes, crossbows). ASSET: one desktop game-interface mockup, 16:9-like landscape canvas 1536x1024, one single screen (not a sheet of variants). Interface frames: dark soot-brown leather and aged paper panels with thin ink rules, muted ochre accents, flat readable shapes, generous spacing; the painted game area uses the same restrained graphic-novel rendering. Text: only the few short Russian labels given in quotes, rendered small and plain; every other text-like element is a neutral grey placeholder line. Icons are simple flat ink pictograms. Information hierarchy must be readable at thumbnail size. Original Warwrit layout: do not imitate any existing game's interface, logo, font or branding. No watermark, no emblems or heraldry, no runes, no magic effects, no sci-fi elements. SCREEN: Strategic world map of a river borderland seen from above at a slight tilt, painted terrain: river, fords, forest masses, marsh, fields, small timber villages and one walled town. On the map: the player's band as a small token (cart and five figures), another mercenary band token, a long column of a duke's army (many small figures and wagons) moving along a road with a dotted planned route, smoke over one farmstead. A floating place card at right shows a village vignette, its state label "Занято" and three placeholder situation lines with small icons (bread price up, recruiters, soldiers). Top bar: "День 14", a coin counter, a bread counter. Bottom-left: six tiny round portraits of the company. STYLE: Mature, restrained graphic-novel illustration for Warwrit's serious grounded dark fantasy. Confident irregular hand-inked contours around major forms, broad matte flat washes and coherent shadow masses. Selective interior strokes suggest weathered stone, timber, cloth and leather; do not trace every stone, board, leaf or grass stem. Desaturated slate, soot, umber, restrained ochre and moss olive; naturally warm readable skin. A clear focal silhouette, deliberate negative space, calm secondary surfaces and distinct foreground/middle/distance. Details and strongest local contrast belong to the subject or action. Use the selected graphic-novel reference images as the visual authority; avoid photorealistic surface rendering and smooth CGI. CONSTRAINTS: No invented factions, coats of arms, emblems, gods, holy symbols, magic, glowing effects or story facts beyond the brief. No text except labels explicitly requested, no runes, logos, watermark, border, collage or variant sheet. No cute rounded toys, glossy CGI, photographic texture, all-over grain or dense crosshatching. Do not copy or imitate any existing franchise's characters, art or screens.
